commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: There were two books. One for loads. One for advances.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: The clerk said the second was private.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Private is a useful word when everyone else pays.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: Here. The names were cut out, not crossed out.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I saw the scraps in the stove. I thought they were mistakes.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: Then today we keep the margins. Missing words have edges.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Keep moving. That thing is tracing where we stood.
